Hurt/injury interfering with health or comfort, more than transient (Miller); psychiatric injury; cutting hair (DPP v Smith 2006)

Really serious harm (DPP v Smith 1961); look at whole injuries and victim (Bollom)

Intent to do GBH OR to resist/prevent lawful apprehension – specific intent, life max

Sport, surgery, tattooing/piercing, rough horseplay (Jones), informed risk of infection

England: only for common assault/battery – not ABH+. Abolished in Wales (2022)

Fear of violence on ≥2 occasions OR serious alarm/distress with substantial adverse effect on day-to-day
Best interests + reasonable – not if fear of violence
Superintendent; magistrates within 48 h; DVPO 14–28 days
DAA 2021 replacements (roll-out ⚠)
Right to ask / right to know
Risk assessment → multi-agency meeting for high risk

Abnormality of mental functioning from recognised medical condition, substantially impairing ability; burden on defence.
Unlawful act (Church: some risk of some harm) / gross negligence (Adomako).

Automatic weapons, handguns, noxious-substance weapons (CS spray), stun guns, disguised firearms. 10 yrs.
s. 16 endanger life (no imitation); s. 16A cause fear; s. 17(1) resist arrest; s. 17(2) at time of Sch. 1 offence; s. 18 intent indictable offence.
Loaded shotgun; air weapon loaded or not; other firearm with ammunition; imitation. Burden on D.
≥ 3 years custody → never; 3 months–3 years → 5 years from release.
Require handover, search, detain, stop and search vehicles – reasonable cause to suspect.
At least two occasions (one victim).
Course of conduct amounting to harassment; knows/ought to know (reasonable person). Summary 6 months.
Causes fear on at least 2 occasions that violence will be used. 10 yrs.
Harassment + stalking acts (following, contacting, monitoring, loitering…); s. 4A fear of violence or serious alarm with substantial adverse effect.

Harassment of a person in their home; s. 42 direction to leave.
Racial: threatening/abusive/insulting + intent or likely. Religious/sexual orientation: threatening + intent. AG consent.

Court order; up to 8 days + 7 ⚠; may include warrant to assist entry (s. 48).
16+ with responsibility; child <16; wilfully assaults, ill-treats, neglects, abandons, exposes. 14 yrs ⚠.
